apollo._comment: Apollo MCP is installed via plugin: /plugin marketplace add apolloio/apollo-mcp-plugin && /plugin install apollo@apollo-plugin-marketplace
apollo._comment2: After install, authenticate via /mcp -> Apollo -> Authenticate

twain._comment: Twain MCP via HTTP transport. Set up via CLI: claude mcp add --transport http twain https://mcp.api.twain.ai --header 'X-Api-Key: YOUR_TWAIN_API_KEY'
